items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: "somebody called him Smedley – I said, 'Smedley, why did you not want me?' He said, 'Because you’d be dead in a year’s time.'"

ctx.x: When the – when Basie passed, did you want to run that band? Or was it not . . .

At one point I was asked to front the band, and I was up for consideration. This was before Thad [Jones] or Joe Williams or any of the cats that took over. Was it Frank Foster or whatever. Before any of them were considered, they asked me. Norman Granz was on the board, and Norman vetoed. He said, “No. I will not allow him to do that.” I said – somebody called him Smedley – I said, “Smedley, why did you not want me?” He said, “Because you’d be dead in a year’s time.” So I suppose I have to thank Smedley for not…
How did Norman Granz get the nickname Smitty?
